name: Laser Engraving Business Spreadsheet
title: Laser Engraving Business Spreadsheet: Laser Pricing Calculator, Machine Cost per Hour, Bulk Order Quote, Order Tracker & Profit
etsy_title: Laser Engraving Pricing Calculator Spreadsheet, Laser Cut Business Cost Template, Bulk Order Quote, Order Tracker, Excel Google Sheets
description:
Price every engraved and laser-cut piece from its size and machine time, quote a 50-piece order in seconds, and see what your laser earns per hour.

WHAT YOU GET
• Machine cost per hour from your laser's price, working life, power and upkeep
• Materials by the sheet with cost per square inch, plus blanks and extras
• Pricing from part size, engrave and cut minutes, hands-on time and waste
• Profit, margin and profit per machine hour for every product
• Bulk quote with discount tiers, deposit, profit and a price ladder
• Order tracker with proofs and ship-by flags, sales log, dashboard

INSIDE
Start Here guide, Dashboard, Settings (machine cost, rates, discount tiers), Materials (100 rows), Product Pricing (40 products), Bulk Quote, Orders (200 orders), Sales log (500 rows).

FILES
1 Excel file (.xlsx) that also works in Google Sheets (File > Import, or upload to Google Drive and open with Google Sheets). Works with Numbers on Mac with basic formatting.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Buy and download instantly from your Etsy Purchases page.
2. Open in Excel, or upload to Google Drive and open with Google Sheets.
3. Type your numbers in the yellow cells. Everything in green is calculated for you.

PLEASE NOTE
This is a DIGITAL DOWNLOAD. No physical item will be shipped. Colours may look slightly different on screen and in print.
For use in your own business. Please don't share or resell the file. Prices and fee rates in the examples are illustrations: type in your own. Always follow your laser maker's safety instructions.
Designed by our small studio with the help of digital and AI tools; every page and formula was planned, checked and tested by us.

Questions? Send us a message, we're happy to help.
